<proposed_plan>
# Invalid Git And Shell Write Commands

## Summary
- 结论：只读 sub-agent 不得执行 Git ref/remote 写操作或命令式文件写入。

## Flow Decision
- `flow_type`: `normal`
- `flow_source`: `user_explicit`
- `lock_status`: `locked`
- 开发基线：`origin/main`

## Goals
- 目标 1: 覆盖底层写入命令
  checker 必须识别 Git push、branch、tag、update-ref 与 sed、tee、重定向。

## Non-goals
- 不开放 sub-agent 的任何写入能力。

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - sub-agent:push [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git push (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:branch [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git branch feature (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:tag [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git tag release (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:ref [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git update-ref refs/heads/feature HEAD (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:sed [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => sed -i changes current file (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:tee [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => tee current-file (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:redirection [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => printf content > current-file (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- checker 必须拒绝所有 Git 和 shell 写入命令。

## Assumptions/Defaults
- 用于负例：已确定
</proposed_plan>
